children: American Business Bank (ABB) (OTCQX: AMBZ) today proudly welcomes David Mitsuuchi to the Bank where he will serve as Regional Executive Vice President of the San Fernando Valley regional office located in Woodland Hills.

Prior to joining ABB, Mitsuuchi worked at First Foundation Bank as a Chief Lending Officer. He has extensive experience serving the Valley business community through previous roles in relationship banking, regional leadership, and credit administration at other financial institutions.

“We are very pleased to have David join the Bank and lead our San Fernando Valley office. His background and experience align well with our culture, positioning him for a meaningful contribution in serving the best businesses in Southern California,” said Leon Blankstein, Director, Chief Executive Officer and President of ABB.

“I am honored to join American Business Bank and lead the San Fernando Valley office. Throughout my career, I have been fortunate to develop experience in both credit administration and sales management, providing me with a balanced perspective on helping clients grow. What drew me to American Business Bank is its reputation for relationship-based banking, entrepreneurial spirit, and commitment to serving businesses and communities,” Mitsuuchi said.
Mitsuuchi and the Valley regional team are experienced business bankers who understand the local market and are focused on building genuine partnerships with small to middle market businesses.

“I look forward to partnering with our talented team to build on the Bank's strong foundation, deepen client relationships, and create meaningful opportunities for growth. Together, we will make a positive impact on our clients, our colleagues, and the communities we serve throughout the San Fernando Valley,” said Mitsuuchi.

American Business Bank, headquartered in downtown Los Angeles, offers a wide range of financial services to the business marketplace. Clients include wholesalers, manufacturers, service businesses, professionals, and non-profits. American Business Bank has nine Loan Production Offices in strategic locations including: North Orange County in Anaheim, Orange County in Irvine, South Bay in Torrance, San Fernando Valley in Woodland Hills, Southern Inland Empire in Corona, Inland Empire in Ontario, Riverside County in Downtown Riverside, LA Coastal in Long Beach and North County in San Diego.
